english.note: Use this for a maternal grandmother; it is also a familiar form of address for her.

exampleSentences.english: Grandma, I’ll come visit you later.
exampleSentences.traditional: 婆婆，我陣間過嚟探你呀。
exampleSentences.jyutping: po4 po4 ngo5 zan6 gaan1 gwo3 lai4 taam3 nei5 aa3

english.note: Use 婆婆 for your mother's mother.

exampleSentences.english: My grandmother lives in Sha Tin.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 po4 po4 zyu6 hai2 saa1 tin4

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday term for a grandmother, and also respectfully for an elderly woman when the context makes that appropriate.

exampleSentences.english: My granny came for dim sum today.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 po4 po4 gam1 jat6 lei4 zo2 jam2 caa4
